design_detail: Illustrative 5% wealth tax on the richest Slovaks
quote_original: Keby sa zaviedla daň z bohatstva iba na úrovni 5 %, iba prvá trojica na slovenskom rebríčku najbohatších by za vlaňajší rok odviedla do rozpočtu viac ako 203 miliónov eur.
quote_en: If a wealth tax of only 5% were introduced, the top three on the Slovak rich list alone would have paid more than 203 million euros into the budget last year.
source_title: Konsolidácia podľa Ódora, Fica a Šimečku
grading_note: Her own commentary: she names a wealth tax, computes its yield on the 45 richest Slovaks and asks Slovak millionaires to join the Patriotic Millionaires; the 5% rate is an illustration, not a worked proposal, so grade B.
